Too much pain, limbs to inch by inch broken, face cuts across the face, Du Zhen know, the elegant himself, is now just a pile of bloody pieces of meat. But the woman's gold master refused to die at once, to slowly torture him before he can eliminate the anger in his heart.
The pain was too much to bear, and Du Zhen cried out and sat up in a flash.
Not bad, the limbs have been inch broken Du Zhen surprisingly can sit up, the body is no longer blood and flesh, surprisingly clean and dry. Du Zhen held up the intact hand stunned, the hands of smooth white skin, ten fingers long, than the woman's hands are good-looking. Du Zhen remembers that when he repaired the woman's gold master, it was at night, but now the window has sunlight shining in.
Du Zhen surveyed the surroundings, and found that the surroundings are too familiar, but it is his own home when he was a teenager. Du Zhen panicked and jumped out of bed, ran barefoot into the bathroom, the bathroom sink above the mirror appeared a square 16, 7 years old appearance of Du Zhen. Du Zhen reached out and touched the person in the mirror, grinning, the person in the mirror also grinned at Du Zhen.
Du Zhen slapped himself a few times and realized that it hurt, before believing that he had become small, oh! No, it was reborn.
Haha! No one wants to kill themselves, their hands and feet won't be broken, their faces are still as handsome as jade, and it's not worth it to lie to people! Oh, no, I can only say that cheating women will not pay off, and will get you killed if you run into a man! Hey, in fact, is a woman is also not good to cheat, generally rich women behind a large sum of money gold master, angry gold master, life as play finished, look, Du Zhen is now reborn back to the age of 16 years old.
Determining that he has returned to the juvenile Du Zhen, began to survey his own home. Du Zhen's mother as early as 8 years old in Du Zhen drank a pesticide and committed suicide, and Du Zhen dependent on the life of Du Zhen's short-tempered pork dealer dad. Du Zhen on their own dad really no feelings, as a child to see more of their mother to father scolding, mother can not stand, to give themselves a whole bottle of dichlorvos, relief from the pain, threw down just understand the small Du Zhen.
Du Zhen is full of feelings for his mother, his mother's suicide, so that Du Zhen to his father as an enemy, and bad-tempered Du Dad, simply do not know how to repair the relationship with his only son, he is accustomed to speak with his fists, as a result, the son of his father more and more hate, father and son, such as a bullfighting, living together for eight years.
Du father had wanted to reorganize the family, but every time you look for an object to let Du Zhen ruined, Du Zhen as long as the father to go on a blind date, will go on a blind date to cry their mother, Du father's blind date as long as the first to hear that the father's ex-wife, can not stand the father's domestic violence committed suicide and died, who would dare to go to marry the father of the Du?
After a few times, Du's father also stopped thinking about remarrying, so he kept his son, who was in trouble with him, to live his life.
Du Zhen never regretted his behavior, he felt that it was what his father owed his mother and had to take a lifetime to pay it back.
Du Zhen look at the wall calendar on the wall, it is 1997, outside the sun is still hanging in the east, see the time is morning, and he is wearing shorts and undershirt is still a little hot, then it should be summer now.
Du Zhen feel a smell of sweat on his body, then the family conditions seem to be not good, the family did not install air conditioning, only electric wind diffuser blowing against, Du Zhen's hometown in the summer is quite hot, the highest temperature at noon basically in the 34 degrees or more.
Although Du Zhen's previous life is to rely on women to mix food, but he mixed quite well, relying on women to accumulate a lot of money, it can be said that has been living a life of fine clothes, reborn to the age of 16, a sticky on the quite unbearable, immediately went to the bathroom to take a shower, the family bath with solar energy, Du Zhen wash and give the big sun can put full of water. Changed clothes and father changed down to take the soap powder bubble down, in the water rubbed a few times on the water clean, drying to the yard hanger.
Packed up, Du Zhen want to find some breakfast to fill up, to the kitchen to see, cold pots and cold stoves, just remembered that Du father and his own never at home to eat breakfast, are bought outside to eat.
Du's father gets up every morning at 4 or 5 o'clock to go into the pork, and then rushes to the vegetable market to sell it, and usually does not go home until noon after selling it. Now, Li's father is already selling meat at the vegetable market, and his own lunchtime meal has to be settled at his cousin's house next door.
Looking at the stage Du father left the breakfast money, Du Zhen do not want to go outside to buy food, he turned on the TV, want to see what day is today. On the TV there is a countdown to the return of Hong Kong, Du Zhen took a look, it turns out that today is June 29th ah, there are still two days from the return.
Du Zhen stared at the countdown, jumped up, he remembered, his father is two days before the return of Hong Kong, riding a tricycle in the road to get pork to a truck hit dead, because the time of the crash is very early, the day is not even bright, the truck fled, his father is to the passers-by found before reporting to the police, the traffic police to the arrival of the father's body are cold. Because Du father body no identification, traffic police to Du father's body to the hospital, until noon to contact with Du Zhen.
Although Du Zhen and his father have no feelings, but after all, Du father is his own father, his own rebirth is actually on the anniversary of his father's death, Du Zhen can not help but curse the heavens, why can't you let him be reborn a day earlier, even half a day earlier can be ah, his own father's car accident can be avoided!

Du Zhen ran to the door and stopped?i What could he do out on his own now? Go to the hospital to see his father's body? People will ask how they knew what happened to their father at home, how will they answer?
Du Zhen slowly back to the room, when the traffic police notified Du Zhen, 16-year-old Du Zhen is very confused, only after reading the second year, and his father's feelings are not deep, and not very sad, all the aftermath of their own little uncle open up, Du Zhen's father's father, a total of three, Du Zhen's father ranked second, the eldest in the field, the little uncle home in Du Zhen's home more than 200 meters away, Du Zhen also has a grandmother is with the little uncle over the past. When the funeral, Du Zhen family bottom in front of the relatives of a count, but only a district of more than 10,000 yuan. And Du Zhen's father car accident, because the driver hit his escape, has not caught the perpetrator, compensation also fell through.
Duzhen later is relying on the little uncle life, the house because Duzhen study to money, in Duzhen sophomore sold, sold to the little uncle of a younger brother. 2000 Duzhen hometown of this medium-sized city prices are not high, although Duzhen grew up also know that their own house is cheap, but after all, the price of the house is that kind, Duzhen look at the little uncle to take care of themselves for three years, and did not go to complain about him.
Du Zhen grew up has been his father only a district of more than 10,000 deposits is very skeptical, Du father sold pork for nearly ten years, Du family was originally the city side of the vegetable brigade of farmers, and then due to economic development, urban expansion, vegetable land are expropriated, and vegetable farmers houses are relocated, in the suburbs of the city to allocate a piece of the base, so that the vegetable farmers to build their own houses. A few years later, the place became an urban village, and the main feature of urban villages is the rental houses. The houses built by the vegetable farmers themselves were uniformly specified to be two and a half storeys high, with a two- to three-room foundation. Vegetable farmers usually build that half-story higher, as well as can be rented out to make money.
Du Zhen's house was granted by his father with a dozen cigarettes, and it was one of the best grants of land among vegetable farmers. There was a big empty space in front of the door, enclosed into a yard, outside the yard is a road, in 2001, this road will be expanded into the city's main street, and the houses on both sides of the street were converted into stores. After Du Zhen's house was sold to his brother-in-law, he built three houses in the yard by the roadside and rented them out. With the rent from the three houses alone, there was no need to go to work.
Du Zhen's family built a two-and-a-half-story, three-bedroom house, the money to build the house with land compensation, built and not decorated, Du's father said he would wait for his son to get a wife and then a one-time get well. Du Zhen do not understand, then build a new house did not spend all the compensation money, how the father died after the family only 10,000? According to Du Zhen's grandmother's statement is the money to the second son gambling gambling away, Du Zhen can only believe that kind of statement, after all, the family put the money in the cabinet is the relatives are present before opening, the key is also the younger uncle from the traffic police to get.
Du Zhen went upstairs to his father's room to look at his own large blackened wooden chest, which was said to be his mother's only dowry. There is a big iron lock on it, Du Zhen has seen his father put money into the cabinet countless times. Du Zhen thought, is only more than 10,000 yuan, but also their own take only good, two lives, Du Zhen is not willing to go back to rely on others, the future of their own house rental, in exchange for living expenses, to finish this year's junior high school, will find ways to make money. Du Zhen does not believe that more than ten years of prophets, will not mix well, of course, he is not ready to go back to eating women's rice in this life, there is a rebirth opportunity, there will not be a second time, right? Go back to the old way to get killed, Du Zhen is not so stupid.
Since you want to take the money into your own hands, Du Zhen is ready to smash the lock. The big iron lock is very firm, have to use an iron hammer what can be smashed open, there is no guy upstairs, Du Zhen went downstairs to look for, when Du Zhen eyes swept against the wall of the table of the eight immortals, found that there is a string of keys on the table, the key has been hanging in the waist of the father of the original Du, Du father has always been not away from the body, is not reborn again, the father of the father of the this time, even forget to take away?
It's good to have a key, so you don't have to smash the lock and break it.
Du Zhen took the key to the upstairs, opened the cabinet, the cabinet has a red book, Du Zhen picked up and opened a look, is the mother and father's marriage certificate, the photo Du Zhen parents are exceptionally young and childish, Du Zhen mother is very beautiful, Du Zhen with his fingers touching the photo of his mother's smiling face, tears flowed out, in addition to this wedding photo and ID card on the photo, Du Zhen's mother and then no photo, Du mother's last photo with all the ID card, which is like this one on the marriage certificate, smiling sweetly.
Next to the marriage certificate, Du Zhen saw a passbook, which Du Zhen did not see in his previous life, opened the passbook, above Du father will save a sum of money every year, and the name on the passbook is his son Du Zhen, to the end of last year, Du father a total of 150,000 deposits.
Du Zhen looked at the passbook, the whole person was shaking, on the one hand, angry, on the other hand, touched.
He was angry at his brother-in-law, the key in his previous life should be the same as today, to his father forgot at home, and his brother-in-law even claimed that he got it from the traffic police, why lie, this passbook is the reason why he lied!
No wonder Grandma grabbed her hand before she died and shouted, "Xiao Mao, I'm sorry, I have no face to see your father." 'Xiao Mao' was Du Zhen's nickname. The young aunt who was with her at the time said that her grandmother was sick and confused, and that she was sorry to everyone. The real reason should be that she helped her youngest son swallow his grandson's money, and on her deathbed, her conscience came to her and she confessed to her grandson.
Du Zhen sneered, blood relatives are just so close!
Du Zhen on the other hand, Du father began to feel guilty, always thought his father only know to beat himself, but in fact he also loves himself deeply, the money he earns are prepared for his son, ready to give his son to start a family, his own life has always been simple, in addition to playing mahjong, Du father has no other hobbies. Like Du father such as thirty, forty years old man, money and house, is it really can not find someone to marry? But it was his son who was fiercely opposed to it, and he didn't want his son to suffer before he didn't go through with the remarriage.
Thinking that Du father is now lying in the morgue, Du Zhen can't help but bawl, crying for his waking up to his feelings, crying for his uncle and grandmother's greed, crying for being orphaned at only 16 years old, crying for no one in the world to love him unconditionally anymore.
Du Zhen cried for a while, and then the cabinet turned down, found that there is a metal box containing more than 20,000 cash, which should be Du father this year to earn money, these years Du father to make money more than a year, the passbook in the beginning of the year only to save a few thousand, and then tens of thousands of last year, last year, 35,000 deposits, this year is still in the summer, Du father has already earned more than 20,000, to the end of the year, the passbook should be able to deposit into the 50,000 again. Go to save money Du father should be proud, he earned more and more money for his son ah.
The younger uncle can be dark hearted enough, take away 150,000 passbook not counting, but also take away 10,000 cash, after that is even the nephew's house also embezzled, really his good uncle ah!
Du Zhen put away the passbook, the money in the box did not move, still put inside the cabinet. Restore the contents of the cabinet to its original state, and then take the large iron lock to lock it. Walked to the yard and threw the key into the well. There is still more than 20,000 cash in the cabinet, this time there is no key, little uncle I see how you go to get it!
